Remove duplicate Sheet1 subresult or mark it as duplicate backup evidence.
Use one comparison outcome with total NG rate and defect counts.
Add AWF!9-AWF!13 as primary evidence citations.
Retitle review as function result comparison of New vs Old AWF JIG.
